title: Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 6,463.50 down -202.44 points
text:
Shutterstock photo Thursday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 6,463.50. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.52 billion. Declining stocks led advancers by 2.26 to 1 ratio. There were 961 advancers and 2175 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 4 stocks reached a 52 week high and 32 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed down -3.36% for the day; a total of -213.74 points. The current value is 6,147.13. Skyworks Solutions, Inc. ( SWKS ) had the largest percent change down (-10.65%) while Celgene Corporation ( CELG ) had the largest percent change gain rising 20.69%.
The Dow Jones index closed down -2.83% for the day; a total of -660.02 points. The current value is 22,686.22. Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change down (-9.96%) while Verizon Communications Inc. ( VZ ) had the largest percent change gain rising .36%.
